parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the edge node.

parameters.name: Isp
parameters.description:
The Internet service provider. Valid values:

*   cmcc: China Mobile.
*   unicom: China Unicom.
*   telecom: China Telecom.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SecondaryPublicIpId
parameters.description: The ID of the secondary public IP address.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-secondary-public-ip-addresses --ens-region-id cn-hangzhou-44 --secondary-public-ip-id spi-5wys0pio93c9f9ukzj2f2fwyr --secondary-public-ip-address 12.XXX.XXX.4 --isp unicom --ens-region-ids cn-chengdu-telecom-4 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens DescribeSecondaryPublicIpAddresses --region cn-hangzhou --EnsRegionIds.1 'cn-chengdu-telecom-4' --PageSize 50 --PageNumber 1 --SecondaryPublicIpAddress '12.XXX.XXX.4' --Isp unicom --EnsRegionId 'cn-hangzhou-44' --SecondaryPublicIpId 'spi-5wys0pio93c9f9ukzj2f2fwyr' --method POST --force
